question: When centrifuging human peripheral blood in a density gradient in Ficoll:

options.opa: The mononuclear cells float on the Ficoll.
options.opb: The lymphocytes remain in the background.
options.opc: The erythrocytes float on the Ficoll.
options.opd: The granulocytes float on the Ficoll.
options.ope: The monocytes remain in the background.

analysis: When centrifuging human peripheral blood in a density gradient in Ficoll, the mononuclear cells, which include lymphocytes and monocytes, will float on the Ficoll layer due to their lower density compared to granulocytes and erythrocytes.
